scripts.build: npm run build -w @agree-first/shared && npm run build -w @agree-first/api && npm run build -w @agree-first/web && node scripts/build-hosted.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agree-first/api && npm run test -w @agree-first/web && node --test scripts/astropods-gateway/connect.test.mjs && node --test scripts/astropods-gateway/setup.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run typecheck:hosted && npm run test:hosted
scripts.test:hosted: npm run build -w @agree-first/shared && cd apps/hosted && vitest run
